pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, quiet night atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
The day you left
you didn’t say a word
I thought it was only
a little distance between us

I believed
we would find our way back
like the evening light
returning to the window

[Chorus]
When the night arrives
your memory grows clearer
under the quiet streetlights
my heart keeps calling you

I keep looking at the door
as if you might return
but only the silence
answers me again

[Verse 2]
I sit by the window
looking at our old photos
your smile fades slowly
inside the dim light

Sometimes I wonder
if you cry like I do
and those thoughts
keep me awake again

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Tonight I pour another drink
and whisper your name
in this empty room
your scent still remains

I try to erase you
from the quiet air
but every corner
still remembers you

[Chorus]
When the night arrives
loneliness grows deeper
the day fills itself
with pieces of you

I keep believing
you might come back someday
but only the cold wind
passes through the door

[Outro]
A single light
shines outside the window
I ask myself
